usedFor: LinkedIn Campaign Manager collects ad leads, and Sangam CRM saves each through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sponsored Lead Form Response” in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Ad leads reach your CRM as soon as the form is submitted, ready for sales follow-up.

watchOut: Organic and sponsored forms are separate triggers, so build one template for each lead type you run.
